verdict.rationale: Superset's own docs describe Automations as scheduled, recurring agent runs that execute a prompt on a cron-like schedule in a fresh or existing workspace. Users can manage them from the CLI, the TypeScript SDK and the MCP server, so this is a recurring schedule rather than a one-off launch. The feature is listed on the paid pricing tier, and the runtime probe confirms the hosted MCP server exposes automation tools. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that automations run reliably unattended, and documentation of the execution environment (e.g. whether the host or desktop app must stay running) and of failure handling and retries.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Schedule recurring agent runs (automations) that execute a prompt on a cron-like schedule in a fresh or existing workspace.
Automations run an agent session against a project on a schedule, like a cron job, but the output is a live workspace you (or a teammate) can open, review, and continue interactively.
Use it to manage workspaces, tasks, automations, and the local host server from your terminal or from CI.
Superset MCP server: create Git-worktree workspaces, launch coding-agent sessions, schedule automations, open terminals, and manage tasks on behalf of a Superset user.
